McConaughey and Harrelson Star in Meta-Comedy About Possible Brotherhood

Actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson are co-starring in a new Apple TV comedy series titled 'Brothers'. The show is based on the rumor that they might be half-brothers and explores their real-life bromance. Despite being described as disjointed by one outlet, the series is also called endearing and great, with the actors' charm and chemistry highlighted.
